intent: Observe crash boundaries and dump the recent outbound network-operation metadata associated with an authorized attached process without collecting application payload or input content.

crash_network_trigger.on_native_exception: dump rolling outbound metadata tail, arm post-crash mode, preserve OS crash path
crash_network_trigger.on_java_uncaught: dump rolling outbound metadata tail, arm post-crash mode, call original uncaughtException
crash_network_trigger.while_crash_armed: emit subsequent send/sendto/connect operation metadata immediately if the process remains alive long enough

sources.frida_native: Process.setExceptionHandler plus libc connect/send/sendto metadata hooks; payload pointer is never dereferenced
sources.frida_java: ThreadGroup uncaughtException metadata; original path is preserved
sources.application_exit_info: Android 11+ historical process-exit reason for code that owns the application context
sources.app_callback: owned WebView renderer callback where wired

token_vazio: physical-device Frida execution until a receipt is collected
coverage of applications that are not explicitly attached/authorized
network traffic emitted by another crash-reporter process unless that process is separately authorized and attached
invariants: absence of evidence never becomes absence of crash
payload content never becomes crash telemetry
a crash-triggered dump reports network-operation metadata, not application content
